items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Bix Beiderbecke in the context of discussing 'Singing The Blues' and Red Nichols, but the interviewee (Vic Dickenson) does not respond with any personal anecdote, memory, or statement indicating a direct relationship with Bix.

ctx.x: It was a different type of... It was on a Louis Armstrong type, you know. Louis would have been (?) with these guys. They got their approach(?) from Louis.

One of the things that always seemed odd to me also is... You know, in talking about "Singing The Blues," it's Trumbauer's solo that really seemed to stick in people's mind, and not so much Bix. And...
No, it wasn't. It wasn't as much Bix as it was Trumbauer.
So Bix was looked at as more...
